tools.name: insolvency_check
tools.description: FREE. Has this UK company (name or company number) appeared in Gazette insolvency notices — winding-up petitions, liquidation, administration? Top 3 notices.

tools.name: watchlist_check
tools.description: PRO. Check up to 50 customers/suppliers (names or company numbers) at once for insolvency notices, optionally only in the last N days.

tools.name: new_petitions
tools.description: PRO. New winding-up petitions (creditors suing to wind up a company) in the last N days (default 7) — early warning before a customer or supplier collapses. Optional postcode + radius.

tools.name: area_distress
tools.description: PRO. All corporate insolvency notices (liquidations, administrations, winding-up orders) near a UK postcode in the last N days — for lead gen (asset buyers, insolvency practitioners, recruiters, landlords).

tools.name: company_history
tools.description: PRO. Full insolvency notice timeline for one company (all notices, oldest to newest).
